subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

An adventurous or bold person
solution:
The correct answer is **"Foolhardy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Foolhardy"** means recklessly bold or rash. (अनावश्‍यक ख़तरे मोल लेने वाला; दुस्‍साहसी)

 
 
• **Example:** *He made a **foolhardy**__ attempt to climb the tree to recover his kite.*
 
 
 
• The word adventurous also implies boldness, but the word foolhardy adds the connotation of recklessness.
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Judgemental"** means having or displaying an overly critical point of view**. (**लोगों को शीघ्रता से एवं अनुचित तरीक़े से आंकते हुए; आलोचनात्मक)
 
• **"Debonair"** means charming, sophisticated, or suave in manner. (ख़ुशमिज़ाज)
 
• **"Assaultive"** means inclined to physically attack or harm others. (दूसरों पर शारीरिक हमला करने या उन्हें नुकसान पहुंचाने की प्रवृत्ति)
